summary: Create, watch and steer durable multi-model workflow runs on Agent Hub.

help:
Usage: workflow [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Durable multi-model workflow runs (Agent Hub)

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  guide        How a coordinator plans, runs and ends a workflow.
  create       Create and start a run.
  get          One line per step, then run totals.
  wait         Wait for a run to end, pause or change.
  add-step     Add steps to a run.
  revise       Revise a pending step; a step that has started answers 409.
  remove-step  Remove a pending step.
  cancel       Cancel a run or one of its steps.
  resume       Resolve a paused run.
  list         Recent runs, newest first.
help.guide:
Usage: workflow guide [OPTIONS]

  How a coordinator plans, runs and ends a workflow.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.create:
Usage: workflow create [OPTIONS]

  Create and start a run.

  launched_by and coordinator come from the Aico session unless the file sets
  them.

Options:
  -f, --file <str>                Run definition JSON, or - for stdin.
                                  [required]
  --request-id <str>              Stable id: creating again returns the same
                                  run.
  --max-concurrent-steps <int range>
                                  Steps allowed to run at once.  [x>=1]
  --json                          Print the full API payload.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.get:
Usage: workflow get [OPTIONS] {run_id}

  One line per step, then run totals.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]

Options:
  --json  Print the full API payload.
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.wait:
Usage: workflow wait [OPTIONS] {run_id}

  Wait for a run to end, pause or change.

  Polls until the condition holds. Stops at a finished run or a pause that
  needs a decision.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]

Options:
  --until <str>             done | needs_owner | any-change | step:<key>
                            [default: done]
  --max-wait <float range>  Seconds, then return exit 30. Cancels nothing;
                            default waits without limit.  [x>=0]
  --poll-min <float range>  Seconds between reads after a change.  [default:
                            2.0; x>=0.5]
  --poll-max <float range>  Seconds between reads once nothing changes.
                            [default: 10.0; x>=0.5]
  --max-errors <int range>  Failed reads in a row before exit 31.  [default:
                            12; x>=1]
  --help                    Show this message and exit.

  Exit codes: 0 run completed, 10 needs owner decision, 11 run failed, 12 run
  cancelled, 13 awaited step ended without completing, 20 awaited step done,
  21 something changed, 30 --max-wait passed (run still going), 31 lost
  contact, 1 error.
help.add-step:
Usage: workflow add-step [OPTIONS] {run_id}

  Add steps to a run.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]

Options:
  -f, --file <str>  A step object, a list of steps or {steps: [...]}, or - for
                    stdin.  [required]
  --after <str>     Key of the step the first added step depends on.
  --reason <str>    Why; kept in the plan history.
  --json            Print the full API payload.
  --help            Show this message and exit.
help.revise:
Usage: workflow revise [OPTIONS] {run_id} {key}

  Revise a pending step; a step that has started answers 409.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]
  key     Step key  [required]

Options:
  --set <str>       field=value, repeatable. Lists take JSON or commas; null
                    clears.
  -f, --file <str>  Revision JSON object, or - for stdin.
  --reason <str>    Why; kept in the plan history.
  --json            Print the full API payload.
  --help            Show this message and exit.
help.remove-step:
Usage: workflow remove-step [OPTIONS] {run_id} {key}

  Remove a pending step.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]
  key     Step key  [required]

Options:
  --reason <str>    Why; kept in the plan history.
  -f, --file <str>  JSON {revise: {dependent-key: revision}}, or - for stdin.
  --json            Print the full API payload.
  --help            Show this message and exit.
help.cancel:
Usage: workflow cancel [OPTIONS] {run_id}

  Cancel a run or one of its steps. It stops running work; it never deletes
  history.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]

Options:
  --step <str>    Stop only this step.
  --reason <str>  Why; kept with who asked and when.
  --json          Print the full API payload.
  --help          Show this message and exit.
help.resume:
Usage: workflow resume [OPTIONS] {run_id}

  Resolve a paused run.

Arguments:
  run_id  Workflow run id  [required]

Options:
  --action <str>                retry | skip | fail  [required]
  --step <str>                  Step to act on; default is the paused step.
  --model <str>                 retry: pin this model for the next attempt.
  --extra-attempts <int range>  retry: attempts to allow past the cap.  [x>=1]
  --note <str>                  Kept with the decision.
  --json                        Print the full API payload.
  --help                        Show this message and exit.
help.list:
Usage: workflow list [OPTIONS]

  Recent runs, newest first.

Options:
  --mine                Only runs launched by this session (AICO_SESSION_ID).
  --limit <int range>   [default: 20; 1<=x<=200]
  --offset <int range>  [default: 0; x>=0]
  --json                Print the full API payload.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

usage.when: before first use of the durable runner: plan, wait, revise, end
start a durable run from a step plan; the same --request-id returns the existing run
see each step's status, requested→served model, attempt n/N, live phase, cost and the run totals

usage.cmd: st workflow wait RUN [--until done|needs_owner|any-change|step:KEY] [--max-wait SECONDS]
usage.when: block until the run ends, pauses for a decision, a step ends or anything changes; prints changes; exit code tells which

usage.cmd: st workflow add-step RUN --file step.json|- [--after KEY] [--reason WHY]
usage.when: extend the plan with one or more steps, also after the run completed

usage.cmd: st workflow revise RUN KEY --set field=value ... | --file revision.json [--reason WHY]
usage.when: change a step that has not started: instructions, model, executor, effort, acceptance, max_attempts, depends_on

usage.cmd: st workflow remove-step RUN KEY [--reason WHY] [--file revise.json]
usage.when: drop a pending step nothing else depends on (or revise its dependents in the same call)

usage.cmd: st workflow cancel RUN [--step KEY] [--reason WHY]
usage.when: stop the whole run, or one step while the run carries on; work already done is kept

usage.cmd: st workflow resume RUN --action retry|skip|fail [--step KEY] [--model M] [--extra-attempts N] [--note TEXT]
usage.when: answer a run paused for a decision: retry the step (optionally more attempts or a pinned model), skip it, or fail the run
find runs, or re-attach to the runs this Aico session launched (--mine)
